stage1.impression: A night shopfront seen through a big steel-framed window into a long timber-and-concrete bar, with a frosted lightbox of a dancing woman on the left and the name across the glass. The room behind reads as a competent, uniformly dim CG interior: the glass has no reflections at all, the EARF letters sit on it as flat opaque grey blocks, the lightbox is the brightest thing in the frame and reads as a poster or sign, and no speaker can be found at the far end, so the frame has no hero. As shot, a magazine would see a generic dark bar, not a specific place: the one specific gesture (the dancer lightbox) reads as signage.

blocking_9: The altar pair must read at a glance at the end of the room: region [330,200,470,290] lum_median >= 45 with the speakers' silhouettes and the light through the acrylic distinct from the back wall (now 34, not identifiable even at 5x)
The shopfront glass must behave like glass: faint reflections of the street lamps and the kerb on the panes, not a perfectly invisible plane
The etched name must read as etching (a translucent frost lit by the room and the street), not opaque grey letters floating on the glass
The lightbox must glow below the room's practicals and in neutral white, not as the frame's brightest, mauve-tinted poster
The steel fascia below the window must hold detail (now median 8) and the pavement patch on the right must stop being the brightest flat surface in the frame
No window mullion cutting through the vanishing point and the altar
Delivered at 2400 x 1600 with clean material detail at 1:1 (this proof at 0.3 cannot show formwork grain, fir checks or steel patina)

defects.what: The altar and its speakers are unreadable: the far end is a muddle of dim shapes, lum_median 34; no speaker silhouette or tint can be found
Lightbox is the brightest large area (median 96.5) and tinted mauve (RGB 113/93/96, dE2000 41 vs a warm white); reads as a backlit poster or signage
Etched EARF letters render as flat opaque grey blocks (median 88) with no frost texture, no edge highlight, floating in front of the room
Shopfront glass shows no reflection of the street, the kerb or the street lamps; the panes read as absent
The one visible Dome pendant clips (27% of its area at 255) as a bare white dot; no visible pool of light under it on the counter
Blackened-steel fascia below the window nearly black (median 8.2, p95 19.8); its patina and panel joints barely read
Pavement patch at the doorway is a flat cream plane (median 145), the brightest large surface, with no texture, drawing the eye out of frame
Door recess and right pier 12% crushed; the corrugated panel in the recess reads as a CG texture
Centre mullion runs straight down the vanishing point, splitting the room and the altar
No sign of life legible from the kerb: no figure, no readable glass or coat; tables are evenly lit and repeated, like a showroom

changes.problem: The hero, EARF's pair on the altar, cannot be found; the far end is as dim as the rest of the room.

evidence.measured: lum_median 34.3, p95 86.9; dark zone [415,195,475,275] median 29.1; no speaker silhouette visible at 5x

change.setting: lamps: the altar 2 x spot (and the lamps on each speaker)
change.from: 650 W, cone 18 deg; speaker area lamps 1.0 W/m2
change.to: 1100 W, cone 22 deg; speaker area lamps 3.0 W/m2

changes.expected: The altar becomes the brightest pool at the end of the room, the two cabinets' silhouettes and the light through their acrylic read from the kerb.

changes.problem: The glass shows no reflections and the steel fascia is nearly black, so the shopfront does not read as glass in a steel frame on a street.

evidence.measured: lum_median 8.2, p95 19.8, crush 4.6%; window panes show zero reflection of street lamps

changes.expected: A raking street light picks out the steel's uneven sheen and panel joints and puts faint, clean reflections of lamps and kerb on the panes.

changes.problem: The lightbox outshines the room and is tinted mauve, so it reads as a poster rather than frosted acrylic glowing softly.

change.setting: the room's glowing surfaces: the screens' images
change.to: 0.55, with the screen's white set warm-neutral (no magenta) under the 2900 K white balance

changes.expected: The lightbox sits just below the altar and the pendants in brightness, a soft even warm white with the fogged dancer, not a sign.

changes.problem: The etched name reads as opaque grey letters floating on the glass instead of etching.

evidence.measured: lum_median 88.3, flat fill, no edge highlight or frost grain at 2x

change.setting: the room's glowing surfaces: the window's etched name (and the frosted roughness of the etch)
change.to: emission 0.0, etch transmissive with roughness ~0.35 so it catches the street lamps and lets the room show through

changes.expected: Letters read as a light frost on clear glass, legible but showing the room behind, brighter at edges where the street light catches them.

changes.problem: The Dome pendant reads as a clipped bare dot and the counter has no distinct pool of light under it.

change.setting: EARF's lamps: each Dome liner glow; the Domes' downlights

changes.expected: The Domes glow tinted rather than blown and throw tighter, brighter pools on the zinc counter with dark between.

changes.problem: The pavement patch at the door is the brightest flat surface in the frame and pulls the eye out of the room.

change.setting: materials' finish: the concrete's tone (pavement and threshold)
change.to: mid grey-warm concrete, albedo about half, with a slight damp sheen

changes.expected: The threshold reads as street concrete catching some door light and street-lamp reflection, no longer a bright cutout.

changes.problem: The centre mullion falls on the vanishing point and splits the room and the altar.

evidence.measured: mullion spans the full window height at the frame's centre, crossing the altar zone

changes.expected: The altar sits clear in one pane, a third in from the mullion, with the lightbox and name still in frame.

changes.problem: The room reads as an empty showroom from the kerb; no air, no life.

evidence.measured: tables evenly lit and repeated; no legible glass, coat or figure; no visible beams in the air

change.to: haze 0.012; put the half-drunk coupe and a lit candle on the front table by the window, and the coat on the nearest stool in view

changes.expected: Soft beams under the Domes and altar spots, and a near sign of life at the window that a passer-by would see.

out_of_scope.request: A saturated colour for the hero speakers so the frame has one colour accent
out_of_scope.why: The Smoke configuration fixes every product's tint; the speakers' colour cannot change.

out_of_scope.request: Replace the dancer lightbox's content or move it
out_of_scope.why: The screens and what they show, and the shopfront, are fixed by the room's design.

out_of_scope.request: Fewer or differently placed mullions in the shopfront
out_of_scope.why: The shopfront is fixed design; only the camera can move around it.
